# miBTC One

> Bitcoin Runes Micro-Payment Gateway SDK

miBTC One is the first purpose-built micro-Bitcoin payment system using the Runes protocol on Bitcoin. It enables developers to accept BTC micro-payments with 0.5% fees, instant settlement, and a TypeScript SDK.

## Features

- Runes-native payments on Bitcoin (no bridges)
- Micro-payment optimized (as small as 1 miBTC / 0.001 BTC)
- TypeScript SDK with 12 tools
- MCP server for AI agent payment processing
- Multi-wallet support: Xverse, Unisat, Phantom, OKX
- Merchant dashboard with real-time analytics

## Quick Start

```bash
npm install mibtc-one
```

```typescript
import { MiBTCPay } from 'mibtc-one';

const pay = new MiBTCPay({
  merchantId: 'your-id',
  network: 'mainnet'
});

const invoice = await pay.createInvoice({
  amount: 100,
  currency: 'MIBTC',
  description: 'Premium access',
  callbackUrl: 'https://your.api/webhook'
});
```

## Pricing

- Starter: Free (10 tx/month, 1% fee)
- Pro: $29.99/mo (500 tx/month, 0.5% fee)
- Enterprise: $99.99/mo (Unlimited, 0.3% fee)
